Merge a pull request on GitHub.

Without an argument, the pull request that belongs to the current branch
is selected.

USAGE
  gh pr merge [<number> | <url> | <branch>] [flags]

FLAGS
      --admin               Use administrator privileges to merge a pull request
      --auto                Automatically merge only after requirements are met
  -d, --delete-branch       Delete the local and remote branch after merge
  -m, --merge               Merge the commits with the base branch
  -r, --rebase              Rebase the commits onto the base branch
  -s, --squash              Squash the commits into one commit and merge it

INHERITED FLAGS
      --help                     Show help for command
  -R, --repo [HOST/]OWNER/REPO   Select another repository

LEARN MORE
  Use `gh <command> <subcommand> --help` for more information about a command.
